user.title: Air Quality
user.description:
This integration reads your air quality configuration from `/config/airquality.yaml`.

If the file does not exist, an example configuration will be created automatically.

Click **Submit** to complete setup.

error.yaml_invalid: The configuration file contains errors. Check your Home Assistant logs for details.
error.yaml_not_found: Could not create the example configuration file. Check filesystem permissions.
error.area_not_found: One or more `area` values in your configuration do not match a valid Home Assistant area. Check the area_id values.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload the air quality configuration from /config/airquality.yaml without restarting Home Assistant.

recompute.name: Recompute
recompute.description: Force immediate recomputation of all slot values.

set_threshold_profile.name: Set threshold profile
set_threshold_profile.description: Temporarily override a space's threshold profile at runtime. Not persisted to YAML.

area.name: Area
area.description: The HA area_id of the space to override.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of the threshold profile to apply.

discover.name: Discover
discover.description: Scan HA registries and propose an airquality.yaml configuration. Returns the YAML proposal as response data without modifying the active configuration.

stale_threshold_days.name: Stale threshold (days)
stale_threshold_days.description: Exclude entities whose last_changed is older than this many days.

include_stale.name: Include stale entities
include_stale.description: If true, do not filter by staleness.

write_to_file.name: Write proposal to file
write_to_file.description: If true, write the YAML proposal to /config/airquality.yaml.proposed.

get_ui_state.name: Get UI state
get_ui_state.description: Return the current configuration plus all HA areas and candidate air-quality sensors grouped by area. Used by the optional add-on UI. No side effects.

sync_dashboard.name: Sync dashboard
sync_dashboard.description: Regenerate the managed Air Quality Lovelace dashboard from the current entities and configuration.

slot_unavailable.title: Air quality slot unavailable
slot_unavailable.description: The {measurement} slot in area {area} has no valid source entities reporting data. Check that the source sensors exist and are reporting numeric values.

slot_stale.title: Air quality slot stale
slot_stale.description: The {measurement} slot in area {area} has stale data — its source sensors have not updated within the configured staleness window. Check that the sensors are still online.

missing_profile.title: Threshold profile not defined
missing_profile.description: Space {area} references threshold profile {profile}, but it is not defined in threshold_profiles. Health classification will fall back to UNAVAILABLE for this space until you add the profile or change the reference.

dashboard_sync_failed.title: Air Quality dashboard sync failed
dashboard_sync_failed.description: The managed dashboard could not be created or updated: {message}. Check Settings → Repairs for persistence, or reload the integration after fixing the underlying error.

dashboard_lovelace_not_ready.title: Air Quality dashboard: Lovelace storage unavailable
dashboard_lovelace_not_ready.description:
The integration could not sync the managed dashboard because Lovelace internal storage was missing or incomplete when sync ran (this is separate from whether you can open dashboards in the browser).

Diagnostics:
```
{details}
```
Try: restart Home Assistant, then reload Air Quality or call airquality.sync_dashboard. If this repeats, open a GitHub issue and paste the diagnostics block plus any log lines mentioning **lovelace** or **Setup failed** at startup.

dashboard_sidebar_path_blocked.title: Air Quality dashboard sidebar path blocked
dashboard_sidebar_path_blocked.description:
Another panel already uses the URL path reserved for the Air Quality dashboard.

```
{details}
```
Rename or remove the conflicting dashboard under **Settings → Dashboards**, then reload Air Quality.
